verdict: 2 Critical / 4 Major / 2 Minor / 2 Nit; NOT implementable on current seams

findings.summary: Run-identity exclusivity (trust.py commit_legacy_capture 'legacy capture cannot reuse a P4 execution run' vs commit_p4_batch 'P4 capture cannot reuse a legacy execution run') forbids the mixed v1+P4 capture the composed-tape seam needs: pure v1 cannot re-capture the already-P4-captured data root, pure P4 exposes no member bytes.

P4 commit_p4_batch exposes no member-read seam (CapturedAuthorizationRecord is empty/opaque; LaunchSession kind is captured-authorization-v2, refused by open_capture/captured_bindings), so the manifest producer cannot derive and the ReplayRun cannot verify ordered_envelope_digests against data members; the 'digests are supplied' non-goal is a scope dodge.

No exposed CAPTURED receipt digest on either path: v1 _receipt_digests is private; P4 lifecycle_captured_receipt_sha256 is buried in the private ledger audit and the returned record is empty. An accessor must be public (__all__) and keyed by (stream, consumer_document_sha256).

Location incoherent: the collaborators/verification are broker-issued and the broker is private/unreachable from production; the mint+verify must be pipeline-side (trust.py), contradicting the matrix's proposed dskit/production/replay_tape.py.
Supplied-digests boundary does not close P7's data half: codec _build recomputes only internal digests; nothing binds ordered_envelope_digests/source_rank_policy_sha256 to data members.

Cross-authority/provenance gap: the retained manifest-producer receipt is not a compose_replay_tape parameter and is not recoverable from the ReplayRun's process (record is process-bound WeakKeyDictionary).
codec does not self-refuse data_capture_root == data_captured_receipt or self-recorded manifest root (only placeholder/self literal).
raw legacy ReplayTape admission has no named enforcement seam (bundles.ReplayTape is an open ABC).
source_rank_policy_sha256 provenance/retention unspecified (no seam holds the pre-document roster policy pin).
verification step (5) 'retained replay receipt' is circular/undefined.

disposition: Blocked on a genuine architecture gate (recorded 0176). The composed-tape verification requires member-read (v1-only) AND multi-consumer capture (P4-only), which trust.py's run-identity exclusivity + opaque P4 record forbid together. Requires an owner/ADR decision before RED.
